lines.text: Eliphaz the Temanite says Job once strengthened feeble hands, but now trouble has come upon him.
Eliphaz asks who innocent has ever perished, and says those who sow trouble perish by the breath of God.
A word came to Eliphaz in visions by day, and a spirit glided past his face.
Eliphaz says resentment kills a fool, and the fool's sons are crushed in court without a defender.
Eliphaz says God will rescue Job from ten calamities, and his offspring will be many.
